# Corentin — Full Stack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Corentin, a full-stack developer based in Brussels, Belgium. He builds modern web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and .NET, works at Eachstapp, and is available for freelance engagements. The site is bilingual (English at /, French under /fr).

Key facts:
- Role: Full Stack Developer at Eachstapp (since 2024), open to freelance work
- Location: Brussels, Belgium (CET), works remotely and async-friendly
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, .NET, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker
- Languages: French (native), English (professional), Dutch (intermediate)
- Contact: contact@nitroc.xyz
- GitHub: https://github.com/nitroc-dev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/corentin-d-02472724b
